# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest version released on [WordPress.org](https://wordpress.org/plugins/elio-blocks/) receives security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue, pull request or support topic.

Report it privately through GitHub: **[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/alexandrebuffet/elio-blocks/security/advisories/new)**.

Include what you can of:

- the affected version;
- the steps to reproduce, or a proof of concept;
- the impact (who can exploit it, and what they gain).

You will get an answer as soon as possible. Once a fix is released, the advisory is published, and you are credited unless you prefer not to be.
